## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `ccm-bir` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Implementation present; conformance pending.** An implementation module exists under `src/uiao/adapters/`, but `ccm-bir` is **not yet wired into the UIAO_121 conformance runner** (`tests/test_adapter_conformance.py`). The Tier-1 criteria below are the activation gate, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: reserved (defined when the CCM BIR ships)

**Validation artifacts:** `findings.json`, `metadata.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/ccm-bir/ccm-bir.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `CA-7`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **CA-7** Continuous Monitoring | Primary (reserved) | Once the BIR ships, this adapter is the canonical pathway-1 (modernized) continuous-monitoring evidence path — replacing the manual monthly ConMon cadence with automated emission. |

## Notes from canon

Pathway-1 (modernized) slot reserved for the Collaborative Continuous Monitoring Balance Improvement Release once FedRAMP publishes it. Complements the pathway-2 monthly ConMon meeting + OSCAL drop cadence described in ADR-043 D3. Stub module: src/uiao/adapters/ccm_bir_adapter.py — instantiation raises CcmBirAdapterNotYetAvailable until the BIR ships. Mandatory adoption date (Notice 0009 / 2027-04-01) is earlier than VDR so is the leading deadline in the migration-readiness check.
